# `aitbc analytics dashboard`

Export a complete dashboard data snapshot as JSON.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics dashboard [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | `json` | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics dashboard
```
